rust_summary: the scoreboard: a score read for any objective, a score written, an objective created or removed only in the mod's own `<mod_id>.<name>` namespace, and team membership (the mod's own teams, joined and left only under the rule in `native_scoreboard.rs`).
doc_summary: `scoreboard_score(holder, objective)` reads any objective's score (`None` when missing); `scoreboard_set_score`, `scoreboard_add_score` (saturating), `scoreboard_add_objective` and `scoreboard_remove_objective` write only the mod's own `<mod_id>.<name>` objectives and return `false` when refused; `scoreboard_objectives` lists every objective. `scoreboard_teams`, `scoreboard_team_of(holder)` (`None` on no team) and `scoreboard_team_members(team)` read any team; `scoreboard_add_team`, `scoreboard_remove_team` and `scoreboard_team_join(team, holder)` act only on the mod's own `<mod_id>.<name>` teams, and `scoreboard_team_join` refuses a holder on a team the mod does not own; `scoreboard_team_leave(holder)` leaves only the mod's own team. Writes return `false` when refused. Bundles need "hooks": @API:scoreboard@.
